    io.mcs.taskmanager - package io.mcs.taskmanager
    Task Manager, a desktop to-do list: JavaFX screens over Spring services, its tasks in one SQLite file on this computer.
    io.mcs.taskmanager.entities - package io.mcs.taskmanager.entities
    What is kept: the user's tasks, and the statuses a task moves through.
    io.mcs.taskmanager.repositories - package io.mcs.taskmanager.repositories
    Spring Data repositories, each over one entity of entities.
    io.mcs.taskmanager.services - package io.mcs.taskmanager.services
    What the app does with tasks, and the rules it does it under; the only callers of the repositories.
    io.mcs.taskmanager.shared - package io.mcs.taskmanager.shared
    What every part of the app uses: the folder on this computer the database lives in.
    io.mcs.taskmanager.ui - package io.mcs.taskmanager.ui
    The JavaFX front: DesktopApp, which starts Spring and opens the window; the window's controller, a Spring bean, with the task list, its filters and counts, and the search; the rows of the list; and the dialogs that open over it to add, edit and delete a task.
    io.mcs.taskmanager.ui.kit - package io.mcs.taskmanager.ui.kit
    The pieces the window is built of, in the Intellidger design system: Ui's text, buttons, key caps, alerts and notices, and Icons' line icons and mark.
